password.title: Password
password.description: Selected by the schema format. Length is an ordinary constraint, not something the presentation imposes.

recoveryPhrase.title: Recovery phrase
recoveryPhrase.description: A plain string selected by options.format instead, with no schema format.

verificationCode.title: Verification code
verificationCode.description: A fixed-length code: options.variant otp, with the length fixed by the schema.

backupCode.title: Backup code
backupCode.description: Asks for the same variant, but the schema does not bound its length.

hint.title: Password hint
hint.description: An ordinary string beside it, for contrast.
